effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 Digimon card with [Gaomon] or [Gaogamon] in its name from your hand face down under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When effects add to your opponent's hand, by suspending this Tamer, you may place the top card of your deck face down under this Tamer. After, 1 of your Digimon with [Gaogamon] in its name can't be deleted in battle for the turn.
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.AQ117:AQ118
